description.narrative: Couvoir Amar (CA) and Africaine de Production Animale (APRAN) (collectively referred to as the Companies or COUVOIR AMAR) aim to integrate the value chain through the establishment of an animal feed plant, additional breeder farms, and chicken broiler facilities. The project will focus on improving feed production and broiler farming efficiency.

The proposed investment is aligned with IFCs strategic approach to Agribusiness. It will enhance food and nutrition security by improving access to poultry products in Senegal. The Project is also expected to contribute to the surrounding community through the new jobs created to operate the expanded facilities and along the poultry supply chain.
Project level outcomes: (i) Stakeholder (farmers) - increased farmers access to poultry inputs such as DOCs and feeds to improve productivity; (ii) Stakeholder (consumers) - contribute to food security by increasing the volume of protein-rich poultry products sold to consumers and improving dietary diversity of households in Senegal and (iii) Economy wide effects - increased value addition and direct job creation along the poultry value chain. Beyond the Project, IFC expects the investment to contribute to increasing competitiveness of the sector in Senegal.
